We buy antiques in Belfast
Sell your antiques in Belfast and beyond

If you have something of interest for sale we are happy to provide free valuations for your antique items across the Greater Belfast area.

If you are planning to sell your items please just get in touch now so that we can arrange to come along and take a look. Even if what you have is not right for us, we can almost always point you in the right direction.

We are always interested in furniture items like tables. chairs, sideboards etc. We are also interested in Irish silver, paintings, art, jewellery etc. In fact anything of interest that you think we might like just get in touch with us.




Just get in touch

We would only be too glad to talk to you about your valuable items, give us a call or use the enquiry form on our contact page.
